title: hex_encode with_capacity preallocation is the right fix — defend against revert
description: The new hex_encode allocates bytes.len()*2 upfront then writes with fmt::Write, producing zero intermediate String objects. The old Iterator::collect approach allocates one String per byte then concatenates N-1 times inside collect. A contributor might suggest reverting to the collect form for brevity. The current form is correct and the allocation improvement is real, not micro-optimization — blob IDs are 32 bytes (SHA256), so the old code always did 32 intermediate allocations per hex_encode call.
